name: bgit-cli
description: Bitcoin-enabled Git wrapper - timestamp commits with HandCash, and publish whole repositories to BitcoinSV so they can be cloned back with stock git
author: b0ase
contributors: Ryan Bennett <https://github.com/zcoolz> (on-chain repository format: publisher, reader, claim, spec and test vectors — vendored unmodified from github.com/zcoolz/bgit under MIT)
_comment_overrides: Patched transitive deps. @handcash/handcash-connect@0.8.11 is the latest stable release and still pins vulnerable nanoid/joi, so they are forced here. Ranges are pinned WITHIN the existing major line on purpose: an open '>=' range resolves to the newest major, which pulls ESM-only nanoid 4+ into a CommonJS dependency and swaps express 4's path-to-regexp 0.1.x for the incompatible 8.x API. Revisit when handcash-connect 1.0 ships.
